G2 Submit button: Submit

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
  <title>Submit Button</title>
  <style>
    html, body { height: 100%; margin: 0; }
    body {
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
      background: #f6f7f9;
    }
    form { margin: 0; }
    .submit-btn {
      appearance: none;
      border: 1px solid #1a73e8;
      background: #1a73e8;
      color: #fff;
      padding: 0.65rem 1.1rem;
      border-radius: 6px;
      font-size: 1rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: filter .15s ease, transform .02s ease;
    }
    .submit-btn:hover { filter: brightness(0.95); }
    .submit-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); }
    .submit-btn:focus-visible {
      outline: 3px solid #a8c7fa;
      outline-offset: 2px;
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <form action="#" method="post">
    <button class="submit-btn" type="submit" aria-label="Submit">Submit</button>
  </form>
</body>
</html>

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <title>Accessible Submit Button</title>
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
</head>
<body>
  <main>
    <h1>Accessible submit button example</h1>

    <form id="demo-form" action="#" method="post" novalidate>
      <div>
        <label for="email">Email</label>
        <input id="email" name="email" type="email" required autocomplete="email" inputmode="email" />
      </div>

      <button id="submit-btn" type="submit" aria-describedby="submit-instructions">
        Submit
      </button>

      <!-- Screen-reader-only helper text for the button -->
      <p id="submit-instructions" class="sr-only">
        Press the button to submit the form. The button will be disabled while submitting.
      </p>
    </form>

    <!-- Live region for submission feedback -->
    <div id="feedback" role="status" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true"></div>
  </main>

  <style>
    /* Visually hidden but accessible to screen readers */
    .sr-only {
      position: absolute;
      width: 1px;
      height: 1px;
      padding: 0;

      overflow: hidden;
      clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0);

    }
